verse.unicode: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥

transliteration.english: janam maran kaa bhram giaa gobidh liv laagee ||

en.bdb: The illusion of birth and death is gone; I lovingly focus on the Lord of the Universe.

verse.unicode: ਜੀਵਤ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਨਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਜਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

transliteration.english: jeevat su(n)n samaaniaa gur saakhee jaagee ||1|| rahaau ||

en.bdb: In my life, I am absorbed in deep silent meditation; the Guru's Teachings have awakened me. ||1||Pause||

verse.unicode: ਕਾਸੀ ਤੇ ਧੁਨਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਧੁਨਿ ਕਾਸੀ ਜਾਈ ॥

transliteration.english: kaasee te dhun uoopajai dhun kaasee jaiee ||

en.bdb: The sound made from bronze, that sound goes into the bronze again.

verse.unicode: ਕਾਸੀ ਫੂਟੀ ਪੰਡਿਤਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਕਹਾਂ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: kaasee fooTee pa(n)dditaa dhun kahaa(n) samaiee ||1||

en.bdb: But when the bronze is broken, O Pandit, O religious scholar, where does the sound go then? ||1||

verse.unicode: ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਸੰਧਿ ਮੈ ਪੇਖਿਆ ਘਟ ਹੂ ਘਟ ਜਾਗੀ ॥

transliteration.english: tirakuTee sa(n)dh mai pekhiaa ghaT hoo ghaT jaagee ||

en.bdb: I gaze upon the world, the confluence of the three qualities; God is awake and aware in each and every heart.

verse.unicode: ਐਸੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਮਾਚਰੀ ਘਟ ਮਾਹਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥੨॥

transliteration.english: aaisee budh samaacharee ghaT maeh tiaagee ||2||

en.bdb: Such is the understanding revealed to me; within my heart, I have become a detached renunciate. ||2||

verse.unicode: ਆਪੁ ਆਪ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤੇਜ ਤੇਜੁ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥

transliteration.english: aap aap te jaaniaa tej tej samaanaa ||

en.bdb: I have come to know my own self, and my light has merged in the Light.

verse.unicode: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਬ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥੩॥੧੧॥

transliteration.english: kahu kabeer ab jaaniaa gobidh man maanaa ||3||11||

en.bdb: Says Kabeer, now I know the Lord of the Universe, and my mind is satisfied. ||3||11||
